variables.$fxv#0:
<!--
  API-level base policy.
  - Sets the round-robin pool as the default backend.
  - Authenticates upstream with APIM's managed identity (Cognitive Services
    audience).
  - Throttles per subscription (rate-limit: short burst window;
    quota: 24h ceiling). Counter keys fall back to the gateway IP for unauthenticated
    requests; in practice every authenticated caller has a subscription, but the
    fallback prevents a NullReferenceException if the API is ever opened anonymously.
  - Owns the retry budget: only GET/HEAD/OPTIONS, at most four attempts.
    Mutations and analysis POSTs are forwarded once, even on ambiguous errors.
  - Echoes a correlation id (W3C traceparent or x-ms-client-request-id) on
    every response.

  __POOL_BACKEND_ID__ is replaced at deploy time by apim.bicep with the actual
  pool backend name (currently "cs-pool").
-->
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <!-- Durable idempotency is implemented at the Function ingress, not here. -->
    <choose>
      <when condition='@(context.Request.Headers.ContainsKey("Idempotency-Key"))'>
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="400" reason="IdempotencyRequiresFunction" />
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/json</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body>{"code":"IdempotencyRequiresFunction","message":"Use the Function endpoint for durable idempotent mutations."}</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
    </choose>
    <!--
      Reject oversized request bodies at the gateway, BEFORE rate-limit/quota
      counters tick and before the call reaches Content Safety. The
      {{max-request-body-bytes}} named value is substituted as a literal int at
      policy parse time, so this is a pure header-read + constant-compare with
      no Razor evaluation cost. Defense-in-depth: the Function App also caps
      inbound bodies at MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES; this layer protects against
      any future caller that bypasses the function and hits APIM directly.
      check-body-size is intentionally NOT used: validate-content's max-size
      is hard-capped at 4 MB, but our default is 10 MiB.
    -->
    <choose>
      <when condition="@(int.Parse(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Content-Length", "0")) > {{max-request-body-bytes}})">
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="413" reason="PayloadTooLarge" />
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/json</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body>{"code":"PayloadTooLarge","message":"Request body exceeds the {{max-request-body-bytes}}-byte limit."}</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
    </choose>
    <!--
      Throttle per APIM subscription. The retry-after value (seconds) is echoed
      via a 429 response by APIM. Numbers tuned for a thin proxy in front of
      Content Safety: 60 req/min burst, 10000 req/day ceiling.
    -->
    <rate-limit-by-key calls="60"
                       renewal-period="60"
                       counter-key="@(context.Subscription?.Id ?? context.Request.IpAddress)" />
    <quota-by-key calls="10000"
                  renewal-period="86400"
                  counter-key="@(context.Subscription?.Id ?? context.Request.IpAddress)" />
    <set-backend-service backend-id="__POOL_BACKEND_ID__" />
    <authentication-managed-identity resource="https://cognitiveservices.azure.com" />
    <set-header name="x-correlation-id" exists-action="skip">
      <value>@(context.RequestId.ToString())</value>
    </set-header>
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <retry condition='@((context.Request.Method == "GET" || context.Request.Method == "HEAD" || context.Request.Method == "OPTIONS") && context.Response != null && (context.Response.StatusCode == 429 || (context.Response.StatusCode >= 500 && context.Response.StatusCode < 600)))'
           count="3"
           interval="1"
           max-interval="5"
           delta="2"
           first-fast-retry="false">
      <!-- At most 4 x 10 s + 3 x 5 s for reads; one 50 s attempt for writes. -->
      <forward-request buffer-request-body="true"
                       timeout='@((context.Request.Method == "GET" || context.Request.Method == "HEAD" || context.Request.Method == "OPTIONS") ? 10 : 50)' />
    </retry>
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
    <set-header name="x-correlation-id" exists-action="override">
      <value>@(context.RequestId.ToString())</value>
    </set-header>
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>
variables.statelessPolicy:
<!--
  Stateless policy: round-robin via the pool. No ownership or idempotency state.
  Used for:
    - POST /image:analyze
    - POST /text:detectGroundedness
    - POST /text:detectProtectedMaterial
    - POST /text:shieldPrompt
    - GET  /text/blocklists  (list — see README "Notes & limitations")
-->
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>
variables.blocklistPolicy:
<!--
  Stable ownership: SHA-256(UTF-8 blocklistName), first byte modulo two.
  Never fall back to the pool: a missing or unavailable owner is not evidence
  that the other account has the same data. Existing lists must be migrated
  to their deterministic owner before enabling this policy.
-->
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <set-variable name="blocklistBackend" value='@{
      var name = (string)context.Request.MatchedParameters["blocklistName"];
      var hash = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create().ComputeHash(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(name));
      return hash[0] % 2 == 0 ? "cs-primary" : "cs-secondary";
    }' />
    <set-backend-service backend-id='@((string)context.Variables["blocklistBackend"])' />
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>
variables.analyzeTextPolicy:
<!-- Text analysis using blocklists must run on the account owning those lists. -->
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <set-variable name="blocklistBackend" value='@{
      try {
        var body = context.Request.Body.As<Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject>(preserveContent: true);
        var names = body["blocklistNames"];
        if (names == null || names.Type == Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JTokenType.Null) { return ""; }
        if (names.Type != Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JTokenType.Array) { return "invalid"; }
        var owner = "";
        foreach (var name in (Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JArray)names) {
          if (name.Type != Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JTokenType.String) { return "invalid"; }
          var hash = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create().ComputeHash(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes((string)name));
          var backend = hash[0] % 2 == 0 ? "cs-primary" : "cs-secondary";
          if (owner != "" && owner != backend) { return "mixed"; }
          owner = backend;
        }
        return owner;
      } catch {
        return "invalid";
      }
    }' />
    <choose>
      <when condition='@((string)context.Variables["blocklistBackend"] == "mixed" || (string)context.Variables["blocklistBackend"] == "invalid")'>
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="400" reason="InvalidBlocklistRouting" />
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/json</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body>{"code":"InvalidBlocklistRouting","message":"Provide valid JSON and blocklistNames belonging to one backend. Split analyses across owners explicitly."}</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
      <when condition='@(!string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)context.Variables["blocklistBackend"]))'>
        <set-backend-service backend-id='@((string)context.Variables["blocklistBackend"])' />
      </when>
    </choose>
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>
